'''To Know the Unknown''' is the ending theme for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. It is featured on the film's [[Pokémon 3: The Ultimate Soundtrack|soundtrack]] and is performed by {{wp|Innosense}}.
